title: potentilla recta subsp. tenuisepala
intro: Potentilla recta subsp. tenuisepala, commonly known as a species of cinquefoil, is a type of flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions such as fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal issues due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla recta subsp. tenuisepala include its ability to modulate immune responses, exhibit antioxidant activity, and display potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
